posts.title: Adventures in Vibe Coding and Agentic Engineering

posts.title: One Simple Thing: Do Deep Squats
posts.description: I'm getting older, which is not fun. Still feeling great, but definitely realizing that I'm no longer young. Little things are starting to ache, but overall, I feel comfortable and confident in my body. Which I'm extremely grateful for! But I've started looking at ways to stay strong and healthy as I continue to age. And the one thing that I'm finding extremely valuable is practicing deep squats!
